## Pull request overview

This is a routine patch release coordinated via changesets, bumping all 20 packages in the fixed versioning group from 2.0.5 to 2.0.6. The release follows the established changeset workflow with automated CHANGELOG generation.

**Changes:**
- All 20 @objectstack/* packages in the fixed versioning group bumped to 2.0.6
- Per-package CHANGELOG.md files auto-generated with dependency updates
- Main CHANGELOG.md updated with [2.0.6] - 2026-02-11 entry
- Example packages independently versioned (patch bumps for their internal dependency updates)

### Reviewed changes
